propositions: A code-verifiable AC retagged [operator-attested] bypassed plan-review guards and was accepted at completion despite having exact repository path/symbol evidence (tests/unit/test_scan_scoping.py cited verbatim)

The evidence-kind criterion failed to fire on a tagged repository-provable AC during re-review execution, and det_measurement_provenance detected missing provenance: lines but remained advisory, allowing the verdict to pass

A deterministic close-path guard (det_attestation_launder.laundering_gaps) now rejects tagged ACs whose own block text cites exact repo paths/symbols or pytest node IDs before the completion verifier runs

Legitimate external ACs with valid provenance: continuation lines continue to pass; mixed criteria (repo + external evidence) are blocked with split coaching to move repo citations to an untagged criterion
The fix is wired into close_precheck._completion_precheck as txn.ensure_attested_items_valid, firing after ensure_ac_boxes_checked and before the LLM verifier, with --force bypass available

Detection uses precision-first matchers (repo-root paths, code-extension slash paths, test_* symbols, pytest ::node IDs) while scrubbing URLs and deliberately not matching commit hashes or Gerrit numbers per ADR-0043
